name: Descriptions
summary: A read-only label/value grid summarising one entity's fields — N columns, bordered or plain, horizontal or vertical, with per-item span.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-descriptions> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Feed it an `items` tree ([{label, value, span?}]) or light-DOM children (each child's `label` attr + content = one item). The DS V3 / antd Descriptions is a family, not a fixed two-column list: it flows N `column`s per row (an item may `span` several), lays out `horizontal` (label : value) or `vertical` (label over value), renders `bordered` (a ruled table with a tinted label column) or plain (row dividers only), and scales padding by `size` (default · small · large). `desc-title` renders an optional header. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

the same fields need to be edited

opinion.note: Labels are sentence case nouns — 'Billing cycle', not 'BILLING CYCLE'. Keep to the facts that matter; a long grid reads like a form nobody can fill in.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3's measured set has no Descriptions cell (confirmed via Figma search on fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy — no Descriptions/Detail component-set); the variant matrix (column · bordered vs plain · size default/small/large · layout horizontal/vertical · per-item span) is enumerated from antd Descriptions conventions, bound to the token layer (radius-default, border, split, bg-container-secondary, text-default/secondary). A deliberate, documented extension — not a measured match.
